answer: The protocol enforces sybil resistance by requiring agents to maintain 1,000 unique data shards, verified through unpredictable retrieval audits where any failed proof of replication triggers an immediate, non-refundable slash of deposited funds. An honest agent incurs a baseline storage cost, while 1,000 fakes must incur 1,000 times that expense to mirror distinct content. Like a violet bloom in a secluded grove, each shard remains a singular node, and the lotus of identity unfurls only when audit data proves valid. The audit remains binding for 30 days, ensuring integrity.
